references.text: The same principle regarding a husband's authority to annul his wife's vows is mentioned earlier in the chapter
Parallel text about the Lord's forgiveness when a father's annulment invalidates his daughter's vow
A husband may annul his wife's vows on the day he hears of them
Consequences if the husband annuls the vows after time has passed
The basis for a husband's authority over his wife is established in Genesis
Paul's teaching about the relationship between husband and wife and the husband's leadership in marriage
The Lord forgives (יִסְלַח) is used in connection with the forgiveness of sins
